title: Answer: consciousness is the joint completion of two loops in layer 5 neurons

statements.text: Consciousness, both phenomenal and access, involves the simultaneous completion of the cortico-cortical and thalamo-cortical loops through dendritic processing in layer 5 pyramidal neurons. Its state and its contents are two sides of that coupling.

sources.quote: It hypothesizes that both AC and PC involve simultaneous completion of these loops due to dendritic processing.
